latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video in Filmora

- Instantly convert up to five product photos (JPG) into 1080p animated video clips through simple prompts—no manual editing required.
- All video rendering, compression, and export happen securely on remote GPU servers; nothing to install locally.
- Automatically manages authentication (with support for free trial tokens) and session creation for seamless workflow.
- Upload images and customize your output with prompts (e.g., add transitions, music); results ready for download in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports common formats (MP4, MOV, GIF, etc.) and provides usage tips, error handling, and smart prompt-to-action mapping for a smooth user experience.
